name: cio_brief_consistency_lq1318_20261109
comment: LQ-20261107-1318 (operator 2026-11-08 20:22 ET: 'why did we get two different results? why wasn't it
uniform?'): the 18:00 CIO preview was hand-composed prose and disagreed with the brief Home renders.
scripts/lib/cio_brief_consistency.py makes a claim without a row a FAIL instead of a surprise: every
synopsis line must carry source_ids, every id must resolve to a row or a named feed, every summary
sentence must name a symbol the brief has a row for or carry a source tag, a summary (or synopsis)
saying 'no cause' about a name whose research row names one is a contradiction, and a document whose
schema is not CIOOvernightBrief@v1 is refused rather than passed empty. run_check() ties every
run-scoped piece (synopsis, each stop_advice row) to the document's run_id, or to its clock within
60 minutes, and lists a piece with neither as unverifiable. The same-run stamp reaches Home through
since_close_card.cio_brief_block(). Synthetic symbols and documents, no DB, no network.
